name: What is included in a turnkey luxury custom home build?

mainEntity.name: What does turnkey luxury custom home construction actually include?
mainEntity.text: What does turnkey luxury custom home construction actually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turnkey luxury custom home construction should mean the builder handles the project from early planning through move-in readiness, but the exact scope varies widely. In practice, it often includes design coordination, budgeting, scheduling, permit management, site work, framing, mechanical systems, interior finishes, fixture installation, and final quality control. Some builders also include landscaping, pool coordination, smart-home integration, and appliance installation, while others treat those as separate contracts. Because the term is loosely used, homeowners should request a written scope that spells out exactly what is included, what is excluded, and who is responsible for each trade. This is especially important on complex Los Angeles projects where design changes, city approvals, and utility coordination can affect timing and cost. A proper turnkey agreement reduces stress, but only if the builder’s responsibilities are clearly defined before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: A true turnkey luxury custom home build should include preconstruction planning, design coordination, permitting support, construction management, inspections, finish selection guidance, and final homeowner walkthroughs. It may also include site preparation, utility coordination, landscape integration, and post-completion punch-list work, but each builder defines turnkey differently.
